Each carries `PERMISSION.md` stating: the date, who asserted it, that this repository
verified no licence grant, and that a rights-holder objection will be honoured with

## What this table does not prove

- **That the merge is good.** It proves the material is present and legal, not that the
  curation is right. The measured argument lives in `specs/gates.json` and
  `tools/gate-docs.py`.
- **That the permissions are real.** Four folders are here because the maintainer says
  they may be. No licence grant was verifiable upstream; `PERMISSION.md` says so in each.
